most_likely_actual_diagnosis_free_text: Shiga toxin-producing E. coli hemolytic uremic syndrome (STEC-HUS) with hemorrhagic colitis; the alternative is TMA/HUS triggered by chemotherapy or cancer
one_line_reason: Bloody diarrhea and edematous colitis, followed by oliguric AKI, thrombocytopenia, very high LDH and schistocytes, is the classic diarrhea-associated HUS (STEC-HUS) pattern, which is not on the list. Complement-mediated TMA is the closest listed option but is less likely.
